staffSession.name: ym_staff
staffSession.description: Staff-only HttpOnly session. CSRF protection is mandatory for cookie-authenticated writes. Must not be interchangeable with the student session.

bearerAuth.description: WeChat student session token with verified audience. Not a way to submit arbitrary roles.

accessToken.description: Only returned for explicit student bearer transport. Never persist in logs.
